name: Aetherborn Tutor
text: Search your library for a nonland card with mana value less than or equal to the number of differently named tokens you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
flavorText: The Aetherborn, shaped by their short existence, chase meaning with fervent intensity. For some, this means embracing thrill and adventure; for others, it involves immersing themselves in pure sensation and pain. A rare few, however, dedicate their brief lives to amassing objects, ideas, and experiences for future Aetherborn.

name: Annihilatog
text: Sacrifice a nonland permanent: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
flavorText: If there's a will, there's a meal.

name: Bloody Murder
text: Destroy target creature. Create a number of Blood tokens equal to that creature's toughness.
flavorText: The rain poured as Calder lit a cigarette, staring down. Hazel Lockhart — his first case, his first obsession, and the first to lie to his face. He found her again at Olive's, shadows dancing in her eyes, fear mingling with secrets. In a city like this, he thought, you never forget your first — whether you're the detective, the lover, or the killer.

name: Body Inspector
text:
Flash
When this creature enters, create a Spike token, then create a Spike token for each creature that died this turn. (They're artifacts with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent gains an emblem with 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.'")
flavorText:
"The perfect candidate. It's as if he knows where the crime will occur before it happens."
—Department Recommendation Letter

text:

{2}: Transform this artifact.

name: Day of the Gorgon
text: Petrify all non-Gorgon creatures. (To petrify a creature, exile it. Its controller creates a copy of it, except it's an artifact.)
flavorText:
"Sisters, the time has come to rebuild Ravnica, stone by stone."
—Vraska, the Coiling Usurper

name: Forbidden Knowledge
text:
Exile your hand. For each card exiled this way, search your library for that many cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle. If this is the second time you've cast a spell named Forbidden Knowledge this turn, you may cast a spell from your hand by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
Cipher

text:

text:

At the beginning of your end step, if this card is in your graveyard, you may pay {B}. If you do, cast it without paying its mana cost.

name: Himoto, Kaito's Pet
text:
This creature and equipped creature can't block and can't be blocked.
Whenever this creature or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library and put them into your hand. You lose life equal to their total mana value.
Reconfigure—{2} or 4 life.

text:

Artifact cards in your hand have reinforce 2—{1}{G} ({1}{G}, Discard the card: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.)
Creature cards in your graveyard have scavenge {2}{G} ({2}{G}, Exile the card from your graveyard: Put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this card's power on target creature. Scavenge only as a sorcery.)

name: Last Will
text:
Enchant creature you control

flavorText:
"We play a different game around here, partner."

name: Leyline of Greed
text:
If this card is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield. If you do, target opponent controls you during your next turn.
Spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.
{2}{B}, Pay 2 life: Draw a card.
flavorText: Where untold power and the desire to explore it converge.

name: Malakir Highborn
text:
Flying
When this creature enters, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a null counter on it. As long as it has a null counter on it, it's a black Zombie named Mindless Null with base power and toughness 2/2, loses all abilities, and has "This creature can't block unless you control a Vampire." (Its enter the battlefield abilities still trigger.)

name: Mindclogger
text:
When this artifact enters, target opponent shuffles four Confusion cards into their library. (Confusion is a colorless sorcery card with no mana cost that has cycling {2}.)
Your opponents reveal each card they draw. Whenever they reveal a Confusion card this way, they lose 5 life.
{2}{B}, {T}: Target opponent shuffles two Confusion cards into their library.
flavorText:
"Of course it's a repurposed Izzet Mind-Enhancer. We love irony around here."
—Yariva, Dimir Engineer

name: Necrogenic Face-Gear
text:
For Mirrodin! (When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it.)
Equipped creature gets +1/-1.

• Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Equip {1}

name: Night to Remember
text:
Spectacle {X}{R} (You may cast this spell for its spectacle cost rather than its mana cost if an opponent lost life this turn.)
Create three tapped Fireworks artifact tokens of any combination of colors. If this spell's spectacle cost was paid, instead create X of those tokens.
flavorText: The Rakdos Cult occasionally hosts "normal" parties to maintain the facade of not being JUST a murder cult.

name: Pull from the Static Noise
text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card with an impending counter on it.
As long as this spell is encoded or is in your graveyard, whenever you cast a spell, if it has the same name as a spell you've cast this turn, you may pay {U}{U}. If you do, copy target spell card from exile with an impending counter on it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Cipher

name: Restless Tracker
text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, study. (Create a Scroll token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Learn.")
Sacrifice three tokens: Return this creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

name: Salvage Automaton
text:
You may sacrifice an artifact rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Return Salvage Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: The Architects salvaged his father to create him; now, he'll salvage them to recreate his father.

name: Sign Off
text: Destroy target creature or enchantment. Its controller draws two cards and loses 2 life.
flavorText: "My body is willing, my blood flows pure as crimson, my intentions remain untainted, my questions echo unanswered, and my patience wears thin."

name: Sleep of the Sleepless
text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with three stun counters on it.
flavorText: "Give him a minute... or two... or three..."

text:

text:

name: Well-Balanced Account
text:
Pay 1 life: You get a debt counter. (At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {1} for each debt counter you have. For each {1} paid this way, remove a debt counter from you. At the end of your end step, you lose 1 life for each debt counter you have.)
Whenever you lose life from your debt, you draw that many cards.
